storage: one immutable JSONL(.gz) file per REPDTE quarter under <archive>/fdicbankfinancials/<REPDTE>.jsonl.gz — a published quarter never changes so it is gzipped immediately and never re-fetched once present
written_by: server/fdicBankFinancials.ts refreshFinancials (24h poll checking for a new REPDTE; cheap 1-record probe until a new quarter actually publishes, eager boot)
source: FDIC Bank Data API /banks/financials — keyless JSON. HOST NOTE: api.fdic.gov (banks.data.fdic.gov 301s there, same probe finding as fdicfailures). ~4,352 institutions at the latest quarter (REPDTE), stable CERT-ordered pagination verified live 2026-07-20 (limit hard-caps at 10000/page; a >10000 limit 400s with validate:too_big). REPDTE arrives YYYYMMDD (normalized to ISO)
license: FDIC public data (US government agency); attribution 'FDIC Bank Data API'

field_map.repdte: reporting quarter end date, ISO, normalized from REPDTE (YYYYMMDD)
field_map.roa_pct/roe_pct: return on assets / equity, percent as published (ROA/ROE)
field_map.nonperforming_pct: nonperforming assets as a percent of total assets (NPERFV)

confidence_model: RAW official quarterly regulatory financials. Same regional-bank-stress hypothesis family as fdicfailures (join on CERT), gate-locked: gate 1 = cross-check a known-failed bank's last snapshot before failure against its fdicfailures record; gate 2 = deposits_uninsured_k/deposits_k spikes and nonperforming_pct deltas vs forward KRE/regional-bank returns. Needs >=2 archived quarters to compute ANY delta — not testable from this session's single snapshot alone.
cadence: quarterly (REPDTE publication); 24h poll makes quiet stretches between quarters a single cheap probe request
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). BUILD ORDER 6 #3 v2 — the documented follow-up to fdicfailures v1 (fdicBanks.ts docstring, filed 2026-07-06); EDGE DOCTRINE #2 territory (small regional banks — whales can't fish there).
